0022600223.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-7, 11th in the West) host the Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 13th in the East) as they look to bounce back from a three-game losing streak, with a 3-3 home record against a Nets team on a two-game skid and a 1-5 road mark. The Pelicans are without Trendon Watford (ankle) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), both out, while Trey Murphy III is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and is a game-time decision. Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise), who is out, and Mikel Brown Jr. is day-to-day with rest and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the last meeting was a 116-113 New Orleans win for the Pelicans on January 14.
